r236634124.text:
TL;DR - Good if you're looking for a bare-bones digging experience, but hold off for a while if you're looking for something more substantial.

I'm a big fan of "Digging" games like this, however this one seems like an early beta/playtest.  This isn't marketed as EA and doesn't have a roadmap or anything, so I can only assume this is the final vision.

The jetpack has no fuel gauge, so you can just keep on jetpacking forever.  Upgrades just make you fly faster.  So you have no incentive to upgrade it more than a couple times.

The digging tool has no real upgrade path.  It starts as a chainsaw and upgrading it just slightly increases the digging radius.  You don't start with some sort of pickaxe and go to a chainsaw.  The chainsaw doesn't visually change.  There is no energy/fuel gauge, so there's no reason to go back to the surface if you don't need to sell.  The chainsaw visibly starts to glow, so it seems like there should be some sort of heat aspect, but it doesn't overheat.  The chainsaw sounds like a dentist drill.

The backpack upgrades are always just a flat "double the size".  The last upgrade had me selling a full pack for $40k or something.

The stuff you sell is "ice" I guess.  Items that you pickup just adds a larger amount of pack space.  So there's no real good feeling when you start finding new items.  When the pack is full, you can just keep drilling.  So once you fully upgrade the chainsaw and backpack, there's no reason to go back to the surface.

There are lights you can buy and place to light up the hole you dig, but going deeper doesn't seem to make the game any darker, so there's no need to place lights.

Dynamite exists, but it's not really needed and doesn't seem to have upgrades.

There's a tent at the surface that seems like does something, but there's no notification of it doing anything.  I'd guess it saves the game, but I don't know for sure.

There doesn't seem to be anything to the hole.  No collectibles, no hidden side paths, it's not even that big of a hole, you can stand in the center and spin around and hit the sides at the full range of the chainsaw.

There's no real UI.  You don't know what exactly an upgrade does.  Other games would say "digging radius 1 > 2" or "jetpack speed 2 > 3" or something.

For now, It's a refund for me.  I do plan on keeping an eye on it, I'd like to buy it again if it gets fleshed out.

r236561103.text:
Für meine 2€ kann ich mich nicht so wirklich beschweren. Man bekommt, was man erwartet. Aber wo ich dann doch erst am überlegen war, ob mein Daumen runter geht, war der Sound. Der ist einfach pure Folter. Das klingt, als würde man gerade eine Füllung beim Zahnarzt bekommen, während die Helferin dabei auf einen Sack voll Pfandflaschen einschlägt. Ich habe die Soundeffekte dann komplett stumm geschaltet. Aber so fehlt halt auch irgendwie was. Und das Dynamit ist einfach eine Frechheit. Das ist null sein Geld wert mit den mickrigen Löchern. Ich empfehle dann doch eher Meltopia. Das ist wirklich schön. Dem Game hier gebe ich eine neutrale 5/10. Und immer schön Gehörschutz tragen, beim Arbeiten mit einer Motorsäge XD.

Edit: Der Entwickler hat direkt den Sound verbessert. Hätte ich nicht mit gerechnet. Hier wird Update um Update raus geballert. Aber viel höher werde ich mit meiner Bewertung nicht gehen. Man gräbt sich hier halt nur gerade nach unten, es gibt nichts zu entdecken und mach hat alle Upgrades nach nicht mal einem Viertel von dem Spiel. Finale 6/10.

triage.english:
For my €2 I can't really complain. You get what you expect. But what almost made me give it a thumbs down was the sound. It's just pure torture. It sounds like you're getting a filling at the dentist while the assistant beats a bag full of deposit bottles. I muted the sound effects completely. But then something is missing somehow. And the dynamite is just a rip-off. It's not worth the money at all with these pathetic holes. I'd rather recommend Meltopia. That's really nice. I give this game a neutral 5/10. And always wear hearing protection when working with a chainsaw XD.

Edit: The developer improved the sound right away. I didn't expect that. Updates are being pumped out one after another here. But I won't rate it much higher. You're just digging straight down here, there's nothing to discover and you have all the upgrades after not even a quarter of the game. Final 6/10.
triage.summary: Sound design is torturous and needs improvement; dynamite is poor value; game lacks discovery and content depth.

reply.text: Vielen Dank für das detaillierte Feedback und toll, dass dir die Soundverbesserung gefallen hat! Wir arbeiten weiterhin daran, das Spiel zu verfeinern.
reply.english: Thank you for the detailed feedback, and we're glad you appreciated the sound improvement! We're continuing to refine the game.

details: Depth 410m and beyond: dynamite and torches no longer damage ice. Persists across multiple attempts (100 dynamite thrown, 100 torches thrown, continuous digging). Resolves on game restart. May be related to a progression lock or depth-based game state issue.

I4.fixPrompt:
Players of Digging A Hole In Ice With A Chainsaw are reporting a bug on Steam. Find the cause in this codebase and fix it.

Bug: Ice stops breaking at 410m depth
Area of the game: depth progression, ice breaking
Reported by 2 players (German, Korean), between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-01.

What the reports say about reproducing it:
- Depth 410m and beyond: dynamite and torches no longer damage ice. Persists across multiple attempts (100 dynamite thrown, 100 torches thrown, continuous digging). Resolves on game restart. May be related to a progression lock or depth-based game state issue.
- At exactly 400m depth, the chainsaw behaves unexpectedly: instead of removing ice, it appears to create new ice or drag existing ice. Player was able to work around it by digging at the pit's edge to reach 500m depth.

Player reports (translated to English):
- Steam discussion reply (2026-10-01, written in German): "I think it's really good how quickly you respond to criticism here. The ice destruction itself is now much more pleasant. But honestly, I don't notice a big difference with the saw. At exactly 400m there's unfortunately also a bug with the ice. Instead of removing it, you somehow create new ice with the saw, or pull the old one with you. It's really strange there. Fortunately, I found a spot at the edge of the pit where I was barely able to dig myself down the last 100m."
  https://steamcommunity.com/app/3958210/eventcomments/594068734660926138/#c594068734660970660
- Steam discussion reply (2026-10-01, written in Korean): "From 410m onwards, nothing gets scraped away.... Even throwing 100 dynamite, even throwing 100 torches, even digging all day long, the ice stays the same. I don't know what the bug was, but it worked when I restarted the game."
  https://steamcommunity.com/app/3958210/eventcomments/594068734660962823/#c594068734660964482

Work out the most likely cause from the code, fix it, and tell me what you changed and how to test it. If the reports aren't enough to pin it down, say what to ask the players.
I4.fixReason: The depth counter now stays readable until you're 20 m from the bottom of the pit. Before, it turned into symbols 100 m early, so it was hard to tell how close you were

I5.summary: Player enjoyed the gameplay loop and progression but found the ending unsatisfying.

releases.name: Update 1.1
releases.notes:
Thanks for all the feedback on day one! This update makes upgrades cheaper and fixes a few bugs you ran into.

Improvements

- 
The first jet boots upgrade now costs exactly one full bag ($100), and the first bag and saw upgrades are cheaper

- 
The last three upgrade tiers are much cheaper, so you can max everything in a normal playthrough

Fixes

- 
Fixed a rare freeze on the loading screen at startup

- 
Fixed the camera lurching when you dig while walking

- 
Minor cleanup and stability fixes

Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Update 1.2
releases.notes:
You wanted to dig deeper, so the pit is now five times as deep.

New

- 
The pit is now 500 m deep instead of 100 m, so you have time to get every upgrade

- 
A new hint the first time your bag is full: go up and sell at the pipe

Fixes

- 
Fixed dynamite and lanterns disappearing when thrown in a narrow tunnel

Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Update 1.3
releases.notes:
A small update for the ending and for your ears.

Improvements

- 
Digging is easier on the ears: softer ice smashes and a less shrill chainsaw

Fixes

- 
Fixed the ending looking like a sudden cut to black: the camera now turns so you see all of it, on Steam Deck too

Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Hotfix 1.3.1
releases.notes:
Sorry! Update 1.2 broke the deeper part of the pit: it had no walls and no loot, so you could dig right out of the level. This hotfix fixes it.

Fixes

- 
The walls and loot in the deeper part of the pit are back

- 
If your save is outside the walls, you start again at the surface. You keep your money and upgrades

- 
The bottom of the pit is now sealed, and the thin gaps where the wall sections meet are closed

Thanks for reporting it so quickly. If you still find a way out of the pit, tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Update 1.4
releases.notes:
A small one: you can now always tell how close you are to the bottom.

Improvements

- 
The depth counter now stays readable until you're 20 m from the bottom of the pit. Before, it turned into symbols 100 m early, so it was hard to tell how close you were

Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Hotfix 1.4.1
releases.notes:
Sorry to everyone who got stuck deep in the pit: from about 400 m down, the ice sometimes couldn't be broken. This hotfix fixes it.

Fixes

- 
Fixed ice from about 400 m down that sometimes couldn't be broken: the chainsaw and dynamite did nothing, or the ice seemed to grow back, until you restarted the game

Thanks for the reports! If anything else gets in your way, tell us in the Steam discussions.

— Danny

releases.name: Digging A Hole In Ice With A Chainsaw is out now!
releases.notes:
It's out! Trapped in a pit with a chainsaw, you dig down through the ice, sell what you haul up, and buy upgrades and dynamite to go deeper, faster.

About the game

- 
Dig: carve your way down through the ice

- 
Sell what you haul up, then buy upgrades and dynamite

- 
A short game you can finish in one sitting

- 
Full controller support, Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud

- 
Oh yeah, there's something waiting for you at the bottom

It's 40% off until October 14. If you enjoy it, a review helps a lot!

— Danny
